clips.prompt: Six-second photographic product-in-context demonstration. clips.prompt: A single stationary six-second photographic home-office tableau, fixed straight-on camera. Exactly three separate products sit on a natural wood desk in one horizontal row with clear gaps. From the viewer's LEFT to RIGHT: an open plain silver laptop on the LEFT, a pair of graphite over-ear headphones resting naturally on their earcups in the CENTRE, and a conventional small wireless mouse lying FLAT on its broad underside on the RIGHT. The laptop screen shows only an abstract teal gradient. The mouse is low, horizontal and ergonomically curved, with its bottom touching the desk; never upright, balanced on an edge, floating or deformed. All three products are already in position at the start and stay completely visible, unchanged and stationary for the entire clip. Wide framing, realistic proportions, soft daylight, plain pale-grey wall. No orbit, pan, zoom, cuts, arriving objects, lid-opening action, extra props, logos, wordmarks, labels, writing, numbers, UI, hands, people or soundtrack.

findings: No visible logos, wordmarks, signage, price numbers, or on-screen text.
Laptop screen shows an abstract teal gradient, consistent with the no-UI requirement.
The center object is headphones, but they are not resting naturally on their earcups; they appear placed in a stand/base, which breaks the prompt.
The right object is a mouse, but it appears upright on its side rather than flat on its broad underside.
The composition is not a clean left-to-right row with clear gaps because the center headphones occupy a large stand-like base and the left laptop is partially cropped.
Overall product arrangement and pose deviate substantially from the prompt despite the correct general object types.

clips.withheld_reason: Rejected: push-in and cropped laptop violate fixed full-object framing. Mouse is flat, contrary to part of QA's rationale; measured failure remains.
